tokens-none.template: at least one: name a token postpaid_config lists

tokens-too-many.template: more than are accepted: name each once, from postpaid_config's list

quote-no-call.template: missing: the call, or its data's length

quote-no-gas.template: missing: needed with only the call's length; or give the call whole

call-no-gas.template: missing: the gas the call is given

authority-undelegated.template: needed: {authority} isn't delegated yet, so the call can't be run to estimate it; give gas, or sign the authorization and quote with authorizationList

authority-and-list.template: with authorizationList: give one or the other

call-length-mismatch.template: {given}, but the call's data is {length}. Leave callDataLength out with the call

gas-over.template: over {most}, the most a call may be given

call-too-long.template: over {most} bytes, the most a call's data may be

transaction-over.template: the transaction needs {needs}, over {most}: give the call less gas, or split it into smaller calls

verify-gas-no-payer.template: only with a payer: name the payer, or leave verifyGas out

factory-fails.template: its factory call fails: {why}. Check the factory and its data, or leave the deployment out if the account exists

deadline-far.template: over {ahead} blocks ahead: name an earlier block

valid-after.template: not valid by the next block: sign it valid from now

valid-before.template: passed: sign the transfer valid for longer

transfer-not-payment.template: the transfer isn't the payment: its to must be the payee, and its value the amount

token-suspended.template: {token} is suspended. Pay in another token postpaid_config lists, or try again later

no-eip3009.template: {token} takes no EIP-3009 transfer: pay in a token x402 takes, or have the call pay for itself

deployment-not-signatures.template: not the one the payment's signature deploys: name that one, or none

authorization-r-s.template: r or s out of range

authorizations-over.template: over {most}: send at most that many

authorization-chain.template: chain id {chain_id}: sign it for this chain, or for any (0)

sponsored-nothing.template: neither a call nor a transaction: give at least one

sponsored-nonce.template: nonce {nonce}, where {following} follows the transaction before it

not-forwarded.template: {token}'s transfer by the forwarder didn't measure: pay in another

sponsored-no-gas.template: missing: the gas the account's code is given, with a call, an authorizationList, or code at the account already

sponsored-over.template: the relay's transactions and what the account is sent cost up to {needs} wei, over the most a sponsorship may: {most}, a transaction of the most gas at the most a block may ask by its deadline

sponsored-unfunded.template: one of the account's transactions can't pay its gas and value: the relay sends it each one's gas and value, but not ETH one sends the forwarder

transaction-chain.template: signed for chain {chain_id}: sign it for this chain

transaction-fee.template: max fee {given}, under {needs}: what a block may ask by the sponsorship's deadline

sponsored-in-flight.template: a sponsorship of {account} is pending: one at a time

paymaster-fields.template: none, but its other fields given: name the paymaster, or leave its fields out

paymaster-pays-by-fees.template: zero: an op with a paymaster pays the relay by its fees

fees-pay-nothing.template: pays nothing a gas as the base fee may fall

fees-estimated.template: above zero: an op paying by its fees is priced by its estimate

limits-given.template: none: a signed op gives its limits

operation-pays-nothing.template: pays the relay's payee nothing, in any token it takes. End its calls with a payment to the payee of what postpaid_quoteUserOperation quotes

eip7702-unsigned.template: none, and the sender isn't delegated: add the sender's signed authorization

signature-refused.template: {whose} doesn't take its signature: sign the op's hash for this EntryPoint and chain

underpaid.template: underpaid: {required} of {token} is required. Sign the payment again for at least that, and send it again

no-capacity.template: no capacity: the queue is full. A payment of at least {required} of {token} would be taken: pay that, or try again in a few blocks

not-accepted.template: {token} isn't accepted: postpaid_config lists the tokens taken

eth-not-accepted.template: ETH isn't accepted here, and an op paying by its fees pays in it. Pay by the op's calls instead (maxFeePerGas 0)

suspended.template: {token} is suspended: {why}. Pay in another token postpaid_config lists, or try again later

wrong-payee.template: the payee is {payee}, not {given}. Pay the payee postpaid_config names

unknown-submission.template: no submission {id}: unknown here, or finished long enough ago to be forgotten. Check the id, or submit it again

not-measured.template: not measured yet: its nodes didn't answer

unknown-fork.template: a fork no schedule knows: a plain call costs {gas}

no-simulation.template: the nodes don't answer eth_simulateV1, which every simulation uses

unknown-fee-formula.template: an OP-stack fee formula Bruno doesn't know: its oracle answers otherwise

block-unseen.template: the nodes aren't at block {block} yet

node-failed.template: a node failed. Try again in a few seconds

no-x402.template: chain {chain} takes no x402 payments: pay through postpaid_sendTransaction, or on a chain that does: see /

revert-underpaid.template: the payee gained less than the payment's amount during the call. Make the call pay it, or pay by a signed transfer

revert-gas-exhausted.template: the call couldn't be given its gas. Quote the call again for its gas

revert-balance-unreadable.template: the payment token's balance couldn't be read. Pay in another token

revert-failed-op.template: the EntryPoint refused the op: "{text}". Check its signature and nonce, and that its account, or its paymaster, can pay for it

revert-failed-op-with-revert.template: the EntryPoint refused the op: "{text}" ({inner}). Check its signature and nonce, and that its account, or its paymaster, can pay for it

params-operation.template: two parameters, by position: the user operation and its EntryPoint

next-retry.template: Try again in a few seconds

next-operator.template: Only the relay's operator can fix this: use another relay meanwhile

x402-no-call.template: the body isn't a call: post the call (to, data) and, if you know it, its gas, for its price

x402-no-signature.template: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is required: sign a transfer for one of these and send it with the same body

x402-token.template: {token} isn't accepted over x402: pay in one the 402 lists

x402-value.template: value isn't the amount {amount}: sign the transfer for exactly accepted.amount

x402-finished.template: {status}: {why}. Pay again, at the price this 402 asks
